about: Profile x set x shape x range x mode rows the daily A/B run measured above 2x Loki. Generated by bench/ab/over2x.py seed and kept by bench/ab/history.py alerts: rows are removed after two consecutive daily runs under 2x and added after two consecutive daily runs above 2x (history.py alerts). The profile is the Loki the row was measured against: aligned (the stack's Loki: align_queries_with_step on, max_cache_freshness_per_query 0s) or loki-defaults (Loki's defaults: off, 10m). See bench/ab/README.md.

profiles.aligned: the stack's Loki (align_queries_with_step on, max_cache_freshness_per_query 0s). It runs only when a proxy build supports -align-queries-with-step, so a row of this profile is judged only on days the profile ran; its list fills itself by the daily rule once it runs. Rows listed before the profiles existed had an unaligned proxy side and moved to loki-defaults, the profile that measures that side.
profiles.loki-defaults: Loki with its own defaults (align_queries_with_step off, max_cache_freshness_per_query 10m); proxy builds run with their defaults. The profile the daily run measures today. Its list holds the rows listed before the profiles existed that stayed above 2x when they moved, and the rows the daily rule added since (above 2x on two consecutive full runs).

rows.shape: LS8 json count by level_extracted, collision
LS8 json count by level_extracted, collision
LS8 json count by level_extracted, collision

rule: proxy time > 2 x Loki time and more than 50 ms slower; both answer 200; on cold, Loki's results cache did not answer
